GOOD QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

What is Aggregate?

Aggregate is a Solana swap interface concept. This interactive preview lets you explore selecting coins, preparing a swap or send, and reviewing the details.

Can I make a real swap?

Not in this preview. Quotes are illustrative, and no funds move. A live version needs a trading integration and transaction signing before real swaps can be enabled.

Do I need to connect a wallet?

No. Choose the demo wallet to explore the experience. It does not connect to a real account or request a signature.

What do the pace settings mean?

Standard, High, and Max show the intended timing options for a future routing service. In this demo they only change the preview; they provide no privacy guarantees.

What does a swap cost?

The preview applies an illustrative 0.3% fee to show how a quote works. This is not a live fee schedule, and network fees are not included.

Can I send to more than one wallet?

You can add up to five recipients in the demo. The estimated output is split equally and the review shows the amount per recipient.
